thresholds.notes: Frost tolerance down to -6 C, as low as -15 C for some cultivars.

notes: Grown as a multi-cut fodder crop; seed-crop flowering stages are not modelled yet.
First cut 50-60 days after planting, then every 30-40 days; 5-6 cuts under irrigation (Feedipedia, citing Suttie 1999 and Gohl 1982).
Does not grow well under hot summer conditions (no numeric limit found).
evidence_gaps: No numeric heat limit found; heat is not assessed.
Waterlogging and disease thresholds are not yet sourced (drought uses the FAO-56 water balance).
Berseem has no row in FAO-56 Table 11; stage lengths need a local source, so growth stages and water use are not calculated.

kc.source: FAO-56 Table 12, https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm ('Clover hay, Berseem', averaged cutting effects)
kc.notes: Not used until stage lengths are known.

water_stress.source: FAO-56 Table 22, https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm ('Clover hay, Berseem', Zr 0.6-0.9 m)
water_stress.notes: Larger Zr of the FAO range, which FAO-56 footnote 1 recommends for modelling soil water stress. Not used until berseem stage lengths exist.
